decisions.reason: Building on the established offer and showing no shortfall relative to aspirations, organizational slack supports keeping it.
As a product line leveraging existing engineering and customer relationships without evidence of shortfall, it is kept under evaluation.
Although close to rather than identical to established conveyors, early results do not signal a shortfall and slack allows continued evaluation.
Close to the core conveyor range with no negative results, it appears to meet aspirations and is kept.
